text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Instead of saying "improve the website," a SMART goal would be "redesign the homepage by June 30." It also helps to define milestones, which are key points along the way, and deliverables, the final products you must hand in. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on these goals from the start. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
